name: 炽焰狮
evolution: 小勇狮 → 炽焰狮 Lv.16 → 炽心勇狮 Lv.36
description: 只是咆哮就能点燃空气，附着火系魔法的利爪能撕裂岩石。喉咙处的火囊发育成熟，可以喷吐高温火球，但偶尔会因能量过载而引发小型爆炸。
descriptionEn: Its roar alone can ignite the air; its claws coated with Fire-type magic can tear rock. The fire sac in its throat is mature, able to spit high-temperature fireballs, but occasionally causes small explosions from energy overload.

skills.name: 气波
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 炎打
skills.description: 造成高额魔法伤害，自己获得物防-40%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals high magic damage; self defense -40%.

skills.name: 淬火
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：下次攻击技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 80%; respond to attacks: next attack skill power doubles.

skills.name: 持续高温
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：下次攻击技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; respond to status: next attack skill power doubles.

skills.name: 怒火
skills.descriptionEn: Gain both attacks +120% and both defenses -40%.

skills.name: 斩断
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外打断被应对技能。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; respond to status: additionally interrupt the responded skill.

skills.name: 焚毁
skills.description: 造成魔伤，驱散敌方所有印记，每驱散1层，获得物攻+20%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; dispel all enemy marks; for each mark dispelled, gain attack +20%.

skills.name: 叠势
skills.description: 造成魔伤，2连击，每成功应对1次，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; 2 hits; each successful response permanently adds +2 hits to this skill.

skills.name: 爆裂飞弹
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 听桥
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：对敌方造成武系物理伤害，威力与被应对技能相等。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 60%; respond to attacks: deal Fighting physical damage to enemy equal to the responded skill's power.
